patch_description: Proposes a new ANSATZ_SPEC that increases expressivity by (a) alternating the CRX ring parameters along the outer perimeter (crx_ring for half the edges, crx_ring_alt for the other half) to diversify entanglement patterns without increasing total parameter count per layer beyond manageably more keys, and (b) giving center-to-edge hub entanglement its own per-edge parameters (crx_hub_edge_1..4) for edge-specific coupling. Keeps the same overall structure (pre-RY, ring, hub, post-RZ) and data/re-uploading scheme, but increases capacity and diversity to improve validation/test performance and reduce train-test gap while maintaining the required inputs/outputs.
